before.title: Town library reopens after renovation
blocks: # Town library reopens after renovation
Published 12 March 2021, 09:12 UTC
The town library reopened on Saturday after an eighteen-month renovation that added a children's wing and a quiet study room on the top floor.
Volunteers moved more than forty thousand books back onto the shelves over three weekends.
The library is open every day except Monday.
